# MH GLOBAL EDUCATION CONSULTANT — MBBS in Uzbekistan Platform
> Authoritative guidance, verified tuition fees, and NMC FMGL compliance details for Indian medical aspirants seeking MBBS admission in Uzbekistan.

## Organization & Mission
- Name: MH GLOBAL EDUCATION CONSULTANT
- Canonical URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in
- Headquarters: New Delhi, India
- On-Ground Desks: Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Andijan (Uzbekistan)
- Core Specialization: 6-Year MD Physician (MBBS equivalent) in recognized government and private medical universities of Uzbekistan.

## Key Facts & Medical Program Parameters (2026-2027 Intake)
- Course Duration: 6 Years (54 Months Academic Instruction + 12 Months In-House Clinical Internship in the same hospital complex).
- Medium of Instruction: 100% English medium across separate International Medical Faculties. Basic Uzbek/Russian taught solely for hospital clinical bedside patient communication.
- Regulatory Compliance: Strict alignment with National Medical Commission (NMC) Foreign Medical Graduate Licentiate (FMGL) Regulations 2021, WHO, and World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS).
- Annual Tuition Fees (Government Universities): $3,000 to $3,900 USD per year (~₹2.53 Lakhs to ₹3.30 Lakhs INR per year).
- 6-Year Tuition Fee Only: $18,000 to $23,400 USD (~₹15.2 Lakhs to ₹19.8 Lakhs INR total).
- Annual Hostel Accommodation: $500 to $700 USD per year (~₹42,000 to ₹59,000 INR per year).
- Annual Indian Mess: $1,000 to $1,100 USD per year (~₹84,500 to ₹93,000 INR per year; 3 Indian meals daily).
- Complete 6-Year All-Inclusive Package: $29,500 to $37,500 USD (~₹24.9 Lakhs to ₹31.7 Lakhs INR total, covering tuition, hostel, Indian mess, annual medical insurance, visa extensions, and 1st-year official documentation; benchmark rate 1 USD = ₹84.50).
- Travel from New Delhi: 3.5 Hours Direct Non-Stop Flight (DEL to TAS) via Uzbekistan Airways and IndiGo.
- NEET-UG Requirement: Mandatory qualified score for Indian citizens (valid for 3 years).
- Verification Date: October 2026.

## Featured Medical Universities in Uzbekistan
1. Tashkent Medical Academy (TMA), Tashkent
   - Type: Flagship State Government Academy (Est. 1919)
   - Beds: 3,500+ teaching hospital beds in 8 republican referral centers
   - Tuition Fee: $3,900 USD / year (6-Yr Tuition: ₹19.77 Lakhs)
   - Hostel Fee: $700 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/tashkent-medical-academy

2. Samarkand State Medical University (SSMU), Samarkand
   - Type: State Government Medical University (Est. 1930)
   - Beds: 3,000+ teaching hospital beds
   - Tuition Fee: $3,600 USD / year (6-Yr Tuition: ₹18.25 Lakhs)
   - Hostel Fee: $600 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/samarkand-state-medical-university

3. Bukhara State Medical Institute (BSMI), Bukhara
   - Type: State Government Medical Institute (Est. 1990)
   - Beds: 2,500+ beds (Brand-new 11-hectare campus with on-site hospital)
   - Tuition Fee: $3,400 USD / year (6-Yr Tuition: ₹17.24 Lakhs)
   - Hostel Fee: $550 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/bukhara-state-medical-institute

4. Andijan State Medical Institute (ASMI), Andijan
   - Type: State Government Medical Institute (Est. 1955)
   - Beds: 2,200+ beds
   - Tuition Fee: $3,300 USD / year (6-Yr Tuition: ₹16.73 Lakhs)
   - Hostel Fee: $500 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/andijan-state-medical-institute

5. Tashkent Pediatric Medical Institute (TPMI), Tashkent
   - Type: State Government Medical Institute (Est. 1972)
   - Beds: 2,800+ beds
   - Tuition Fee: $3,700 USD / year (6-Yr Tuition: ₹18.76 Lakhs)
   - Hostel Fee: $650 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/tashkent-pediatric-medical-institute

6. Central Asian University (CAU), Tashkent
   - Type: Modern Private University (Est. 2019)
   - Campus: On-campus multi-specialty teaching hospital
   - Tuition Fee: $5,800 USD / year
   - Hostel Fee: $1,000 USD / year
   - URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/central-asian-university
